name: Fate
description: Fate is the Luck elf of Gift2u Elves. Equip 1 Fate per wallet for a chance of a jackpot multiplier on tap G2Ushards payouts (server-side). Jackpot replaces Frenzy on that tap. Rarity is shown by the border color and the Rarity attribute. Gen 1. Badge equip and Fate level live in-game (not frozen on-chain).
